capabilities: Increment the editor font size via a command
Decrement the editor font size via a command
Bind font size changes to custom hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a zoom control; unlike Obsidian's Zoom in/out commands, it changes only the editor font size, not all UI elements.
extras: The README recommends specific macOS hotkeys and asks users to star the repository or support the author with donations; note that the theme/CSS overlap is only that the setting it shortcuts lives in Obsidian's appearance settings.
intentEvidence: adjust font size from hotkeys or the command palette without opening the appearance settings
problem: Obsidian only lets you change font size in the appearance settings, and its built-in Zoom commands scale the whole UI instead of just the editor text.
summary: Command-based font size adjuster that adds Increment/Decrement font size commands for the editor font size via hotkeys or command palette.
